title: Data Capture
description: A full-stack data-capture workbook: land straight on the records table with the entry form ready, shape your own fields, and every record lives in a real database — dark, black-and-white, zero ceremony.

theme.$comment: Capture Data is a tool, not a pitch: no landing page, so the theme carries the whole identity. Dark black-and-white (the saas register's conviction): mode dark opens on true black, the brand resolves to ink-on-ground so buttons read as hard white plates, and the palette de-tints the kernel's blue-gray so the workbook is pure monochrome. The shell and ui blocks stay the dashboard's remix surface — a derived template flips shell.variant, ui.table.style, and ui.forms to wear a visibly different workbook.
